newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower on loose funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower on loose funds.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed lower on Monday as some banks rushed to liquidate excess funds ahead of the end of the current reserve period on Tuesday, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 5.216 percent against Saturday's 5.306 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 5.20-5.25.
The maturation of T$5 billion in NCDs on Tuesday was expected to further ease liquidity, dealers said.
The bond market reported listless trade. The seven-year 86/3 government bond yield was at 5.85.
